title: adopt-run output data
description:
The adoption outcome — what was recorded and where to go next.

``stage_reached``:

* ``adopted_in_flight`` — sidecar + journal record written (status
  ``in_flight``); ``next_block`` hands off to ``status-watch``.
* ``adopted_terminal`` — sidecar + journal record written and the run
  settled ``complete`` through the settle-run mechanism on the directed
  ``terminal_evidence``; ``next_block`` hands off to ``aggregate-check``.
* ``needs_elicitation`` — the result layout could not be inferred; NOTHING
  was written. ``needs_decision`` is True and the reason names exactly what
  to supply (``result_dir_template`` + ``task_count``). ``next_block`` is
  null (a human branch).

stage_reached.description: The boundary the adoption stopped at.
stage_reached.title: Stage Reached

needs_decision.description: True only on needs_elicitation — the caller must supply the named layout fields.
needs_decision.title: Needs Decision

reason.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the adoption outcome.
reason.title: Reason

cmd_sha.description: The DERIVED parameter identity: sha256 of the stripped command (64 hex).
cmd_sha.title: Cmd Sha

status.description: Journal status after adoption: in_flight, complete, or null on needs_elicitation.
status.title: Status

job_ids.description: Job ids recorded on the journal record ([] on the terminal branch).
job_ids.title: Job Ids

task_count.description: The recorded (caller-supplied or inferred) task count.
task_count.title: Task Count

sidecar_path.description: Absolute path of the written sidecar (null on needs_elicitation).
sidecar_path.title: Sidecar Path

next_block.description: The {verb, why, spec_hint} hand-off — status-watch on the in-flight branch, aggregate-check on the terminal branch, null on needs_elicitation. verify-reproduction in external-baseline mode is the claim-comparison path once results are aggregated.
next_block.title: Next Block
